messages:
Rina (Security): Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands re: partner evidence for SOC2/ISO. We promised a short checklist + office hours.

Omar (CTO): Agreed. Split guidance into: network (VPC/peering), KMS/BYOK, audit log exports (format + retention), and artifacts for auditors.

Samira (Compliance): For SOC2 minimal artifacts: architecture diagram, control owner list, sample access-review evidence, key rotation logs, and signed shared-control attestation. ISO adds key lifecycle and algorithm notes.

Felix (Infra): We can emit daily JSONL exports to partner buckets. Filename pattern: partners/<partner-id>/audit-YYYYMMDD.jsonl. Each record will be one JSON object: ts, request_id, principal, action, resource, success. Example line: {"ts":"2024-10-12T22:30:12Z","request_id":"r_abc123","principal":"svc-partner","action":"Invoke","resource":"/v1/generate","success":true}.

Drew (DevRel): I’ll draft the partner README + quickstart checklist (include BYOK test command) — ETA 8 business days.

Rina (Security): BYOK acceptance checklist (high-level): key policy binds Redwood service account, key access logging enabled, rotation cadence documented, and test decrypt workflow. Decide if HSM-backed BYOK triggers a security review (recommend yes).

Samira (Compliance): Also add sample support transcripts and incident ticket redactions — auditors ask for those during testing.

cal-bot: "Partner Evidence Office Hours" created weekly starting 2024-10-10, Thursdays 10:00-10:30 PT. Invites sent.

Rina (Security): Action items / owners / due dates:
- Drew: README + checklist — due 2024-10-24
- Felix: log export schema + manifest (sha256 + retention metadata) — due 2024-10-18
- Omar/Product: BYOK acceptance criteria + HSM decision — due 2024-10-16
- Samira: artifact checklist for SOC2/ISO (include transcripts) — due 2024-10-20
Please confirm owners & dates. :thumbsup:

Omar (CTO): Confirmed. Recommend a pilot with one partner (I can introduce BeaconLabs) to validate E2E.

Rina (Security): I’ll create go/internal/partner-evidence and post a link when the draft is live. Thanks all!
